headline: A 1994 executive order keeping existing U.S. export control rules in effect.
what_it_does: Based on its title, this order continues the federal rules that control what goods and technology can be shipped out of the United States. No summary was provided, so the exact details, legal basis, and any changes to the rules are not described here.

who_it_affects.group: Businesses that export goods or technology from the United States
who_it_affects.how: They would continue to follow existing export control rules, such as licensing requirements, rather than having those rules lapse.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed June 30, 1994; the specific effective date is not stated in the provided material.
